title: Roth IRA distribution ordering — Celia Grant
instructions: Celia Grant, age 45, takes a **$60,000** nonqualified distribution from her Roth IRA (first funded 9 years ago). Compute the tax results.

exhibits.title: Account history
exhibits.content:
Regular contributions: **$30,000**
Conversion from a traditional IRA 6 years ago (fully taxed then): **$20,000**
Earnings: **$15,000**

rows.label: Amount treated as a return of contributions
Amount treated as a return of the conversion
rows.explanation: Conversions come out next; the 5-year period has passed, so no penalty: **20,000**.
